description: In combination with `histSST`, quantifies the transient effective radiative forcing (ERF), composition and air quality changes from anthropogenic non-CH4 short-lived climate forcer emissions over the historical period. Same as `histSST`, except anthropogenic non-CH4 tropospheric O3 precursor (NMVOCs, CO, NOx) and aerosol and aerosol precursor (BC, OC, NH3, SO2) emissions are held at 1850 values. Atmosphere-only counterpart of `hist-piAQ`.
branch_information: Branch from `piControl` at a time of your choosing
